title: Short exact Mayer–Vietoris sequence for extension by zero
statement:
Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism], let $X=U\cup V$ with $U,V\subseteq X$ open, and let $F$ be a sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $j_U:U\hookrightarrow X$, $j_V:V\hookrightarrow X$, and $j_{UV}:U\cap V\hookrightarrow X$ be the open inclusions, and write $j_!$ for exact extension by zero [lem-sc-derived-open-restriction-adjunction-exact]. There is a short exact sequence of $\mathcal O_X$-modules
$$
0\longrightarrow j_{UV,!}(F|_{U\cap V})\longrightarrow j_{U,!}(F|_U)\oplus j_{V,!}(F|_V)\longrightarrow F\longrightarrow 0.
$$
The first map is the difference of the two extension-by-zero restriction maps, and the second map is the pair of counits.

source.place: Tag 08BU (cohomology-lemma-exact-sequence-lower-shriek), short exact sequence for a two-open cover

proof.text: For opens $W\subseteq W'$ of $X$ let $\iota_{W,W'}:j_{W,!}(F|_W)\to j_{W',!}(F|_{W'})$ be the canonical morphism of $\mathcal O_X$-modules of [lem-sc-module-extension-by-zero-stalk-maps], with $\iota_{U,X}$, $\iota_{V,X}$ the counits and $\iota_{W',W''}\circ\iota_{W,W'}=\iota_{W,W''}$. Define the first arrow by $s\mapsto(\iota_{U\cap V,U}(s),-\iota_{U\cap V,V}(s))$ and the second arrow by $(a,b)\mapsto\iota_{U,X}(a)+\iota_{V,X}(b)$, the pair of counits. These are morphisms of $\mathcal O_X$-modules, and the composite sends $s$ to $\iota_{U\cap V,X}(s)-\iota_{U\cap V,X}(s)=0$ by transitivity, so the sequence is a complex.

source.place: Tag 08BU (cohomology-lemma-exact-sequence-lower-shriek), proof: the displayed short exact sequence of complexes

proof.text: At every point $x$, compute the stalks of the three terms and of the two arrows using the stalk identifications of [lem-sc-module-extension-by-zero-stalk-maps]: $(j_{W,!}(F|_W))_x=F_x$ for $x\in W$, zero otherwise, with $(\iota_{W,W'})_x=\mathrm{id}_{F_x}$ for $x\in W$. If $x\in U\cap V$, the stalk complex is $0\to F_x\xrightarrow{s\mapsto(s,-s)}F_x\oplus F_x\xrightarrow{(a,b)\mapsto a+b}F_x\to0$. If $x\in U\setminus V$ (respectively $x\in V\setminus U$), it is $0\to0\to F_x\xrightarrow{\mathrm{id}}F_x\to0$ (respectively with the two summands interchanged). If $x\notin U\cup V$, all three nonzero-position stalks are zero. Each displayed sequence is exact by direct module calculations.

source.place: Tag 08BU (cohomology-lemma-exact-sequence-lower-shriek), proof: exactness checked on stalks using Sheaves Tag 00A7 (sheaves-lemma-j-shriek-modules)

proof.text: Exactness of a complex of sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules is equivalent to exactness on every stalk. Applying this stalkwise exactness criterion to the complex in steps 1 and 2 proves exactness in $\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_X)$; together with the zero end terms this is the asserted short exact sequence by the definition of short exact sequence.

split_report.summary: Read Stacks Tag 08BU and its proof, which constructs the extension-by-zero Mayer–Vietoris sequence and checks exactness on stalks. No new node was needed: the existing topological extension-by-zero stalk formula supplies the four pointwise cases, the existing module stalk exactness criterion upgrades those cases to sheaf exactness, and the existing exact-sequence definition supplies the short-exact conclusion. The maps and their signs were made explicit, and the hypotheses are valid for an arbitrary ringed space and open cover.
